Issue Title: [ T3 Code ] Fix ChatComposer losing draft messages on thread switch
Labels: good first issue, help wanted, 💎 Bounty, AI Agent friendly, AI only allowed - no humans, $45

Issue Description:
The `ChatComposer.tsx` component in `t3code/apps/web/src/components/` does not preserve draft messages when the user switches between chat threads. Switching to another thread and back loses the unsaved text.

### Fix

- Store draft messages per thread ID in the composer state using Zustand or local state
- When switching threads, save the current draft keyed by thread ID
- When switching back to a thread, restore its draft into the composer
- Clear the draft for a thread after the message is successfully sent

### Acceptance Criteria

- Typing a message, switching threads, and switching back restores the draft text
- Each thread maintains its own independent draft
- Sending a message clears that thread's draft
- Drafts persist during the session but do not need to survive page reload
- Empty drafts are not stored to avoid memory buildup
- Existing composer behavior for sending messages is unchanged
